modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: On SkyUp flights, the carry-on allowance depends on the fare.

just_fly.value: Regular flights, JUST FLY fare: one free piece of carry-on up to 9 kg, 40x30x20 cm.
just_fly.notes: From the SkyUp group's shared baggage page (skyup.aero), which lists SkyUp MT Limited alongside SkyUp Airlines LLC and Sky Up Nistru as operating entities.

fly_and_smile.value: Regular flights, FLY & SMILE fare: one free piece of carry-on up to 9 kg, 55x40x20 cm.
fly_and_smile.notes: From the SkyUp group's shared baggage page (skyup.aero), which lists SkyUp MT Limited alongside SkyUp Airlines LLC and Sky Up Nistru as operating entities.

fly_and_celebrate.value: Regular flights, FLY & CELEBRATE fare: 2 free pieces of carry-on, each up to 9 kg, 55x40x20 cm and 40x30x20 cm.
fly_and_celebrate.notes: From the SkyUp group's shared baggage page (skyup.aero), which lists SkyUp MT Limited alongside SkyUp Airlines LLC and Sky Up Nistru as operating entities.

charter_standard.value: Charter flights, STANDARD fare: one free carry-on up to 9 kg (55х40х20 cm) and one free checked bag up to 23 kg (158 cm total).
charter_standard.notes: From the SkyUp group's shared baggage page (skyup.aero), which lists SkyUp MT Limited alongside SkyUp Airlines LLC and Sky Up Nistru as operating entities.

extra_piece.value: An extra carry-on piece (up to 5 kg at 40x30x20 cm, or up to 9 kg at 55x40x20 cm) costs from 4/8€ online or via customer support, or 25/40€ at the airport.
extra_piece.notes: From the SkyUp group's shared baggage page (skyup.aero), which lists SkyUp MT Limited alongside SkyUp Airlines LLC and Sky Up Nistru as operating entities.
